# NIRSpec APT Review Tools

**[APT_review.py](APT_review.py)** is the main script. It takes an APT proposal as input and produces a review report and optional plots generated by **[msa_coverage_plot.py](msa_coverage_plot.py)**, **[plot_dithers.py](plot_dithers.py)**, and **[grid_dithers.py](grid_dithers.py)**.

1. Refer to the documentation and update as warranted:
- **[README.md](README.md)**: Overview of the tools.
- **[INSTRUCTIONS.md](INSTRUCTIONS.md)**: This file.
- **[APT_report.md](docs/APT_report.md)**: Full reference for the report metrics.
- **[APT_XML.md](docs/APT_XML.md)**: Reference for the APT XML schema.
- **[APT_exports.md](docs/APT_exports.md)**: Integration guide for CSV exports and **PySIAF**.
- **[ReviewChecklist.md](docs/ReviewChecklist.md)**: Manual review checklist.
- **[SpotlightChecklist.md](docs/SpotlightChecklist.md)**: Strategy and efficiency checklist.
- **[MSATA.md](docs/MSATA.md)**: Target Acquisition and reference star details.
- **[Shorts.md](docs/Shorts.md)**: Automated electrical shorts reporting and multi-program batch review.

2. Test data and results may be found in data/ 

3. Run the script and check the results as warranted or if requested.

4. After every update, push changes to the repository unless explicitly asked not to. Follow instructions in **[GitCommit.md](GitCommit.md)**.
